query: Chur Switzerland taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: The starting price of a taxi in Chur is 8.0 CHF, with each kilometer priced at 4.0 CHF. Uber initial fare 3.00 CHF with 1.80 CHF per km; minimum fare 6.00 CHF, cancellation fee 6.00 CHF. A 5 km ride from a hotel to Chur city center during the day with 1 luggage would cost 28 CHF.
